name: OPSD math competition suite (Qwen3 thinking / TTPO protocol)
description: Measures competition-math accuracy for models trained with OPSD / OPSD-data-lite under the TTPO Qwen3-thinking evaluation protocol. A method reports avg@n on five held-out contests; the score attributable to the method is the delta over the untrained base model under identical generation settings, averaged across seeds.

dataset.notes: The suite evaluates five test sets, all registered under datasets/: aime25, hmmt25, aime26, hmmt26, brumo25. registry_id names aime25 as the primary reference because the schema carries one field; see each dataset directory for provenance and HuggingFace revision pins.
